scope: Only already inspected local production WAM and quality-source paths; no remote, GPU, forward, environment execution, or new data.

findings.claim: Video/action initial noise uses default device torch RNG without an explicit private Generator; quality wrapper captures target CPU/current CUDA RNG before draft/CAL and restores after setup and before each episode reset. Bank reset and READY compare the states.

Observed scheduler set_timesteps/step is arithmetic; VAE wrapper encode_chunk forwards encoder then quant_conv, and WAM _encode_obs takes mu rather than sampling logvar; observed cache path encodes and forwards. No Python random, NumPy draw, torch.Generator, or seed=None-to-random-seed call was found in these inspected production paths.

LINGBOT_SEED seeds global torch and NumPy once at startup. Current quality wrapper does not capture/restore Python or NumPy RNG per episode, but the inspected production policy/video/cache paths show no such draw; therefore no proven active coverage gap.

External diffusers AutoencoderKLWan encoder internals and other unexpanded third-party dependencies were not audited. This receipt does not claim all dependency RNG is covered or attribute any prior failure to randomness.
